findings.summary: The new Delete event affordance leaves the schedule unchanged until the goal is next saved, but the spec requires deleting an event to recompute the schedule.
findings.evidence: affordance.HistoryRow.delete effects: "The schedule is left as it is until the goal is next saved" vs S.webapp.qualification: "Editing or deleting an event must recompute the schedule."

findings.summary: The deferral contradicts the operation the affordance invokes, which recomputes affected goals on every change, and C.webapp.schedule.correct's deleted-events fixture would expect recomputation.
findings.evidence: operation.contact.log effects: "Recompute affected goals without sending anything, ... Deleting an event removes it from history"; C.webapp.schedule.correct claim: "... snooze, pause and deleted events"

findings.summary: Deletion is folded into operation.contact.log, whose preconditions and failures only fit logging (nonfuture event time, future time rejected) and which declares no owned-event precondition.
findings.evidence: operation.contact.log preconditions: [Owned contact, Nonfuture event time]; affordance.HistoryRow.delete preconditions: [Owned contact, Owned event]
